en: Foolish $C!  You are no match for my might!

You are not known to my people.  A kodo is a mighty steed, and it is the product of love and care by my people; such is not given onto strangers.  Until the elders of Thunder Bluff consider you to be a friend, I cannot offer you the sale of a kodo.
My Lord Abernathy sends this to you.
Look inside the Gallows' End Tavern's main dining room for Austil de Mon.  The tavern is on the southeast edge of Brill.
** PLANTED. CONFIRMING WAR RIDER LOCK. STAND BY. T-MINUS 60 SECONDS. **

I think not. Rimblat has already proven that new life can grow from the sundered earth. Now we must find a way to reproduce and, more importantly, sustain the growth.$B$BWhile I am here, I am also offering my services to adventurers entering Naxxramas.
You will not make it to the forest's edge, Fordring.
*Threshwackonator First Mate unit prepared to follow*
<Tarsis is badly injured.>
Up there is where Charlga Razorflank resides. Blasted old crone.
DIE, MORTALS!
Can you see them, mortal? No... I did not think you could. Sighted but sightless - it is your gift and your curse.

Yeah, you'll always find Clyde Kellen fishing on the bank of Brightwater Lake just east of Brill.  Just watch out for psychos wearing masks while you're out there.  We had to shut down the kids' summer camp last year.
You want the Hall of Legends. It's high above the Valley of Strength on the west side. If you're not an officer you can't get in, but you can still talk to Sergeant Ba'sha outside.
So... the Earthen were made out of stone?
Hey Knot - I'm a Tailor.  Think you could teach me how to make the ogre suit?
I cannot teach you tribal leatherworking, $n. You must go to Tanaris and find the home of Narain Soothfancy. Once there, consult the book "Soothsaying for Dummies."
For the Horde!
%s is visibly shaken by the death of Emperor Thaurissan.
Hiccup!
If you have lost a piece of your Zandalarian armor, I may be able to help.
What do you mean by "pure?"
The battle is over, and the people of Darrowshire are saved.
This will not be the end of the Scarlet Crusade!  You will not break our line!
%s summons a messenger...
Your armor looks scary.  Are you scary too?
The spirit of the Dreadsteed pulses with rage.
The Plaguelands are an excellent place to strike against the Scourge!

I am a crafter of some renown, $c. With the proper materials, I am able to craft an armor known as Dreamwalker. Druids - and even some shaman - are drawn to this armor due to its magical properties. Are you interested?

I hear that they have a Mining Trainer in the Undercity.  All you have to do to get there is head south out of town and go to the back of the Ruins of Lordaeron.  Then take the elevator down into the Undercity itself and ask an Undercity Guardian for further directions.
Byancie has often lent her services to the sentinels who patrol the local wilds.  You should talk to her if you desire to learn First Aid.
My strider requires training.
I've been here long enough, $n. I'm sure we'll meet again. Good luck!
I wish to face the Defiler.
